contradictions.fact: Distance and gain from trailhead to high camp

claims.says: ~14 mi and ~4,300 ft each way to camp
Total approach is roughly 8-9 miles with well over 5,000 ft of gain to camp.

contradictions.why: Four fields give four different lengths for the same walk to camp (5.5, 6.3, 8-9 and ~14 mi each way) and two different gains (4,300 vs well over 5,000 ft).

Distance: dist_km 22.53 (14 mi) and the itinerary total (5.5+3+5.5) are both round trips, so 'each way' in totalNote is wrong; the one-way figure is unresolved between 5.5, 6.3 and 8-9 mi.
